content:
maya: Quick sync  Cerulean Systems pilot on Redwood Dedicated wrapped. Product wants a short customer story + a 30m webinar. Need quote, logo permission, and HIPAA-safe assets.
leo: sweet. do we have sharable perf numbers?
samir: we have median p95 and cost deltas in the post-run doc, but Cerulean must approve anything public. recommend conservative quote.
anika: drafting two quote options now. tagging @legal-bot for DPA/logos.
maya: quote A (detailed): 'Cerulean: Redwood Dedicated reduced our p95 latency to ~120ms and cut infra cost per request by ~42%, enabling live inference.'
quote B (high-level): 'Cerulean: Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference latency and lowered infrastructure costs, enabling new real-time features.'
olivia: send B + offer a gated technical appendix if they want numbers public.
legal-bot: Requirements: no PHI in visuals, require written email approval for quote/logo, reference DPA. Provide logo license text to include.
maya: sent B with logo request and asked about a sanitized PNG instead of a dashboard GIF.
cerulean-rep: (customer) We approve the high-level quote and will provide a logo. PNG okay, no GIFs. We'd like to review final copy before publish. Dr. Gomez can join the webinar panel.
leo: drafting run-of-show and scheduling rehearsal next Wed.
ops: can produce a redacted PNG (no IDs, no timestamps). ETA tomorrow.
maya: received customer approval email and logo. legal: can you eyeball final copy?
legal-bot: Approved with edits: include DPA reference and remove exact percent claims unless the customer explicitly okays them by email.
samir: updating public quote to match legal: 'Cerulean: Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference latency and lowered infrastructure costs, enabling new real-time features.'
maya: sending final to Cerulean for sign-off and locking timeline: publish in 11 business days, webinar in 8. saving this thread as canonical approvals channel. :white_check_mark:
